note: Ordinary append vs append-and-continue for the Seg19->Seg20 reveal (both commit Seg20).

ordinaryAppend.behaviour: commits Seg20; keeps the current Seg19 playback frame; pauses
ordinaryAppend.laterPreparationFailure: does not roll back Seg20 (new behaviour)

appendAndContinue.behaviour: commits Seg20; selects the first valid Seg20 frame; continues playback
appendAndContinue.laterPreparationFailure: does not roll back Seg20 (new behaviour)
